title: add transactional downgrade guard, version pinning, backup/restore and schema migrations for private installer
author: Maya Singh
description: Context: Private deployments require a safe upgrade/rollback story for regulated customers. This PR implements a transactional downgrade guard, stronger version pinning, backup/restore helpers, and schema migration tooling for the private installer. Motivation: customers experienced data loss during rollbacks when migrations were not reversible and when manifests drifted between releases. This changeset lays the groundwork for safe, reversible upgrades with explicit guards and observability. Changes: 1) Add an upgrade/rollback coordinator (installer/upgrade/rollback.go) that records transactional steps and exposes a rollback path. 2) Introduce version pinning in installer manifests and helm values; manifests now include a release_version and compatibility metadata. 3) Implement a downgrade guard that refuses rollback if a non-reversible migration was applied; guard logic is pluggable via migration metadata. 4) Add backup/restore scripts and verify helpers (scripts/backup/backup.sh, scripts/backup/restore.sh) with S3-compatible targets and local testing mode. 5) Add transactional schema migrations (migrations/v3__txn_guard.sql) using a two-phase table swap and explicit pre/postcheck queries. 6) Helm chart updates: values validation and a new chart hook for pre-upgrade backup. 7) Terraform module improvements: make the installer module export a post-upgrade hook and expose a backup snapshot output. 8) Integration tests (tests/integration/upgrade_scenario_test.go) that exercise upgrade, verify, and rollback on a local kind cluster. Commits: "init: add rollback coordinator and transactional steps; add migration metadata and hooks; add backup/restore scripts; helm: add pre-upgrade hook and values schema; tf: expose snapshot output; tests: add integration scenario" (commits squashed on merge). How to test: run tests/integration with KIND and local S3 emulation (minio). Run scripts/backup/backup.sh --target=minio --prefix=test-<id> and then attempt upgrade/rollback flow via ./installer upgrade --release-version X; verify DB state and that rollback is rejected when non-reversible migration applied. Rollout plan: merge to main behind feature flag ENABLE_TXN_UPGRADE. After a canary (internal Dedicated clusters) we'll flip feature flag for customers on Dedicated/Private. Backward compatibility: installer will refuse to downgrade across pinned incompatible versions; operators can bypass only after taking a full backup and acknowledging risk. Related PRs: references to previous backup-restore and downgrade guard work for context. Documentation: docs/private-deploy/upgrade-guide.md added with step-by-step instructions.
commits: 7 commits: add rollback coordinator and CLI hooks; add migration metadata and guard; add backup scripts with minio support; helm: pre-upgrade hook and values schema; terraform: snapshot output; tests: integration upgrade/rollback scenario; docs: upgrade guide and changelog entries

release_notes:
- Added transactional downgrade guard to private installer.
- Version pinning and compatibility metadata for installer manifests and Helm charts.
- Backup and restore scripts for S3-compatible targets (minio supported).
- Transactional schema migration pattern (two-phase table swap) to make rollbacks safer.
- Pre-upgrade Helm hook to perform backups automatically when enabled.
testing_notes: Integration tests use KIND + minio; run 'make test-integration' to exercise upgrade/rollback path. CI includes a verify job ci/verify/upgrade_smoke.yml which runs a minimal upgrade/rollback scenario. Manual test: run scripts/backup/backup.sh and scripts/backup/restore.sh against minio, then run installer upgrade and attempt rollback.
notes: Feature gated behind ENABLE_TXN_UPGRADE. Operators must take a backup before forcing bypass; bypass documented in upgrade guide. No breaking API changes to hosted API; only private installer behavior changed.
